Team —

Attached is the Q4 executive headcount packet. We are asking for formal sign-off to proceed to offers for two priority roles:

- VP, Product (req REQ-7892) — strong candidate in final loop; comp in band.
- VP, Infrastructure (internal req) — candidate requires comp-band exception and elevated sign-on due to competing offers.

- Vivek: approval to extend offer to both candidates (VP Prod and VP Infra) and confirm interview + reference checks are complete.
- Laura: confirmation of comp-band exception for VP Infra (spread attached) and recommended offer structure (base + equity + sign-on).
- Markus: operational acceptance for VP Infra start date and any org impacts.

Attachments: Q4_exec_hc_packet.pdf (headcount summary + budget), comp_band_exception_vp.xlsx (proposed ranges).

Please respond with explicit APPROVE / REQUEST CHANGES by EOD Friday (2026-11-20). If approved, recruiting will route offers via DocuSign.

Neha —

Attached: comp_band_exception_vp.xlsx (includes market comps from our compensation benchmark partner and the recommended ranges). Summary below:

- VP, Product: Offer within standard band. Recommended structure: base $285k, target OTE incl. equity $420k, equity 0.6% 4yr vesting.
- VP, Infrastructure: Proposed exception. Recommended structure: base $360k, target OTE $520k, equity 0.9% + one-time sign-on cash $75k (payable over first 6 months). Rationale: 90th percentile market reference for infra leadership due to immediate operational risk and multiple competing offers.

Budget impact: one-off cash sign-on and elevated base will add ~$220k to FY26 cash comp run-rate (calculated in the attached spreadsheet). We recommend using the Q4 executive hiring buffer (see Q4_exec_hc_packet.pdf) to absorb this.

If the team is comfortable with the numbers above, I approve the comp-band exception. Please add a short justification to the Glassdoor/comp-exception ledger for audit trail.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
